title: Alcohol-Free Streak Recovery After Social Events
dataSources: Alcohol habit events (`habit:alcohol`), caffeine intake (`habit:caffeine`), screen-time sessions (`habit:screen`), and fasting windows (`habit:fasting`).
app: Habit-boundary telemetry for Dry January, caffeine cutoffs, screen-before-bed limits, and fasting windows sent to Splunk HEC via apps, shortcuts, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=habit:alcohol
| search recovery_days=*
| stats avg(recovery_days) as avg_recovery_days perc90(recovery_days) as p90_recovery_days count as samples by event_name
| sort 0 - avg_recovery_days
description: Measures alcohol-free streak recovery by social event.
value: Recovery time after a social event shows whether one slip is staying isolated or dragging into a longer slide.
implementation: Send the relevant duration field for alcohol-free streak recovery to `index=personal` and review both average and p90 latency instead of relying on single examples.
visualization: Table of average and p90 alcohol-free streak recovery.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights how long alcohol-free streak recovery usually takes, so slowdowns are obvious instead of anecdotal.
